stabilization.name: Streamline diffusion (SUPG/SD)
stabilization.detail: Adds artificial diffusion along the streamlines to damp the spurious oscillations Galerkin advection produces at high cell Péclet number. 'length_scale: metric' sizes it from the element metric rather than a scalar diameter, which matters on the stretched cells an ALE mesh develops.

stabilization.name: Backflow stabilization
stabilization.detail: Penalises inflow through an outlet. Without it, reverse flow over part of an outlet cap during diastole feeds unbounded kinetic energy back into the domain and the solve diverges — the classic open-outlet instability.

stabilization.name: Pressure fixing
stabilization.detail: Pins the pressure at one point to remove the constant null space. Not needed when an outlet prescribes pressure — a Windkessel does, which is why it is off here.

stabilization.name: Velocity–pressure coupling
stabilization.value: fractionalstep  ·  scheme=CT  coupled_velocity=off  robin_bc_velocity_scheme=implicit  transpiration_bc_projection=robin  flux_report_normalize_boundary=3
stabilization.detail: A fractional-step (projection) scheme splits the saddle-point system into a tentative-velocity solve, a pressure Poisson solve and a correction — cheap, at the cost of a splitting error at the boundary.

stabilization.name: Windkessel treatment
stabilization.detail: Implicit coupling folds the 0-D outlet into the pressure operator as a low-rank correction instead of lagging it as an explicit Dirichlet value, which is what makes a compliant outlet stable at physiological R and C. 'condensed' holds the pressure constant over each outlet by condensing its DOFs.

notes: Reconstructed P_l vs the solver's checkpoints: -6.1 to -0.7 mmHg — the bed integrates the flux implied by the pressure solve, a few per cent above the written velocity's.
